description: Play a free Sudoku puzzle in your browser. Choose a difficulty, add notes, check your answers or reveal a hint.

title: Free Tic-Tac-Toe Online — Play vs Computer

title: Free Online Chess — Legal Moves & PGN

title: Free Online Solitaire — Klondike Card Game
description: Play Klondike solitaire in your browser. Move cards by suit and rank, draw one or three cards, and undo moves locally.

title: Free Online Minesweeper — Safe First Click
description: Play Minesweeper in your browser with a safe first click, three board sizes, flags, a timer and no account.

title: Free Nonogram Puzzle — Unique Logic Picross
description: Solve a free nonogram puzzle in your browser. Use row and column clues to reveal a unique 5×5 picture logic grid.

title: Free Sliding Puzzle — 3×3, 4×4 and 5×5
description: Play a number sliding puzzle in your browser. Choose 3×3, 4×4 or 5×5, move tiles and solve the board.

title: Online Screen Ruler — Measure in Pixels

title: Online Protractor — Measure an Angle

title: Printable Label Maker — Free A4 and Letter Sheets

title: Free Poster Maker — Create a Printable Poster

title: Free Certificate Maker — Printable Award Template

title: Free Invitation Maker — Printable Event Invitation

description: Estimate a taxable amount using a canton and recipient-specific exemption and rate that you enter.

title: Swiss Child Support Budget — Transparent Household Scenario
description: Allocate a documented child budget in a transparent household scenario. This is not a legal maintenance award.

title: Word Hyphenation Preview — Browser Language Patterns
description: Preview browser hyphenation for your text in its language. Pattern support depends on the browser and its installed language resources.

title: Local Spell Checker — Use Your Browser Dictionary
description: Edit text with your browser’s native spellcheck and copy it locally. Language coverage depends on dictionaries installed on your device.

title: Graph Paper Generator — Free, Custom & Printable
description: Create free printable graph, dot and isometric paper. Set A4, Letter or custom size, spacing, margins and color; download SVG or print at scale.

title: Knitting Gauge Calculator — Free Stitch & Row Planner
description: Scale stitches and rows from your swatch to a target size. Adjust repeats, symmetry and shaping, then print a clear knitting worksheet.

title: Free Bead Pattern Generator from Image — Beads or Cross-Stitch
description: Turn your own image into a counted bead or cross-stitch pattern. Limit colors, choose grid size, view the symbol legend and export locally.

title: Codebreaker Game Online — Daily and Custom Logic Puzzles
description: Crack a hidden color code in this free browser game. Choose code length, symbols and duplicate rules; use position and color clues. Play daily or practice locally.

title: Five-Letter Word Game — Choose a Language or Your Own Word List
description: Play a daily or practice five-letter word puzzle with a clearly selected word language. Use the optional Bokmål bank or load your own list; the interface language never chooses the answer language.

title: Play Contract Bridge Online Against Local Computer Players
description: Practice a hand of duplicate contract bridge against three beginner-level local computer players. Bid, follow suit, control dummy as declarer and see a clear score. No online multiplayer.

title: Play Farkle Online — Local Dice Game Against Computer Players
description: Play a local six-dice Farkle game. Choose a scoring table, opening score and target; roll, keep scoring dice, bank points or risk them. No account or online opponents.

title: Foot Length Converter — Compare Your Shoe Size Chart
description: Measure both feet, convert length units and compare with a shoe chart you provide. See the longer foot and avoid generic brand or country size assumptions.

title: Child Growth Percentile Calculator — CDC US Reference
description: Plot height, weight and BMI percentiles against an explicitly selected CDC United States reference for ages 2–20. Measurements stay local; no diagnosis or country assumption.

title: Free 3D Model Viewer — Open STL, OBJ, glTF and STEP Files Locally
description: Inspect STL, OBJ, glTF/GLB and STEP files locally. Rotate, zoom, view mesh measurements and save a screenshot; files are not uploaded.

title: Free DXF Viewer — View Layers, Measure and Export SVG
description: Open ASCII DXF drawings locally. View supported 2D lines, circles, arcs and polylines, toggle layers, measure distances and export the supported geometry as SVG or PNG.

title: Grade Scale Generator — Free Points-to-Grade Tool
description: Turn points into percentages and grades with your own thresholds. Preview the full scale, copy or export it, and print a grading sheet.

title: Binairo Online — Free Random Binary Logic Puzzles
description: Play fresh 6×6, 8×8 and 10×10 Binairo puzzles. Use unique rows and columns, avoid triples, request a hint and check a solution.

title: Phonetic Alphabet Converter — Free NATO Spelling Tool
description: Convert text to NATO phonetic words and back. Includes radio-style number words, punctuation, optional browser speech and a quick practice mode.

title: Norway Holiday Pay Calculator — Free Gross Estimate
description: Estimate Norwegian holiday pay from your holiday-pay basis. Compare common rates for standard leave, a fifth week and employees aged 60 or over.

title: Currency Converter — Free Rates, Fees & Offline Tools
description: Convert NOK, CHF, EUR and major currencies using dated ECB reference rates. Compare fees and exchange margins, convert a list of amounts, and save rates on this device.

title: Norway Tax Calculator 2026 — Free Salary & Pension Estimate
description: Estimate 2026 Norwegian income tax on standard salary or full-year old-age pension. See annual and monthly net pay, tax components and compare two scenarios.

title: Norway Wealth Tax Calculator 2026 — Free Estimate
description: Estimate 2026 Norwegian wealth tax from homes, shares, business assets, cash and debt. See the state and municipal split, valuation discounts and a value sensitivity range.

title: Swiss UID Validator — Free CHE Number Check
description: Check a Swiss UID/CHE number or a list of up to 100 in your browser. Free to use, no account or registry lookup; format and checksum checks do not confirm a business or VAT status.

title: Swiss Salary Calculator 2026 — Gross to Net Pay Scenario
description: Estimate Swiss employee payroll deductions for 2026. See federal AHV/IV/EO and unemployment contributions, then enter your actual pension, accident insurance and source-tax amounts for a useful 12- or 13-pay scenario.

title: Swiss Tax Calculator Companion — Compare ESTV Results
description: Compare annual Swiss income and wealth tax scenarios using figures from the official ESTV calculator. See the tax breakdown and effective rates without relying on copied or stale canton tables.

title: Swiss AHV Pension Calculator — 2026 and 2027 Scenarios
description: Estimate a Swiss AHV/AVS old-age pension from your official determining average annual income and contribution years. Includes current 2026 and announced 2027 amounts and the 13th old-age pension.

title: Swiss Pillar 3a Tax Calculator — Contribution Limits and ESTV Comparison
description: Check Swiss pillar 3a contribution deduction limits for 2026 or 2027 and compare annual tax amounts from the official ESTV calculator before and after a contribution.

title: Swiss BVG Pension Calculator — 2026 and 2027 Minimum Scenarios
description: Estimate Swiss mandatory BVG coordinated salary, annual retirement credit and a transparent projection for 2026 or 2027. Enter your pension-fund terms for a personal comparison.

title: Swiss Pension Withdrawal Tax Calculator — Compare ESTV Scenarios
description: Compare pension lump-sum tax scenarios using results from the official Swiss ESTV calculator. Combine benefits due in each tax year and compare only matching household and municipality inputs.

title: Swiss Health Insurance Franchise Calculator — Compare Annual Costs
description: Compare Swiss basic health insurance deductibles with the premiums offered to you and your own eligible treatment-cost scenarios.

title: Swiss Premium Subsidy Calculator — Your Net Premium
description: Calculate the net premium from the monthly reduction already granted by your Swiss canton. Eligibility and award amounts are not inferred.

title: Swiss Rent Adjustment Calculator — Reference Rate Scenario
description: Estimate only the mortgage reference-rate effect on Swiss residential rent using the rate in your lease and the latest official rate.

title: Swiss Vacation Accrual Calculator — Prorated Leave Balance
description: Estimate vacation days accrued in a Swiss employment year from the annual leave in your contract, work schedule, employment dates and leave already taken.

title: Swiss QR-bill Generator — Free QR Invoice Maker
description: Create and check a Swiss QR-bill locally. Validate IBAN, QR-IBAN, QRR and SCOR references; print the A6 payment part and receipt without uploading invoice data.

title: Swiss Coordinate Converter — Free LV95, LV03, WGS84 & UTM
description: Convert Swiss LV95/LV03, WGS84 and UTM coordinates in your browser. Check CRS, datum and approximation notes; convert a point or up to 1,000 rows to CSV.

title: Swiss Vehicle Tax Calculator — Compare 26 Cantons Free
description: Compare 2026 annual vehicle-tax examples across all 26 Swiss cantons. Select two published reference cars, sort the results and export CSV. Free, local and transparent.

title: Ring Size Calculator — Compare Your Measurement with a Current Chart
description: Convert a ring inner diameter or finger circumference, then compare it with a current size chart you choose. No country system is assumed.

title: Dead Pixel Test — Free Screen Color & Pixel Check
description: Check your display with solid colors, grayscale, gradients and a grid. Use optional fullscreen or a slow manual cycle; this visual test cannot repair or certify a screen.

title: FPS Test — Free Browser Frame-Rate Check
description: Measure the browser animation frame rate with a controlled canvas test. Compare frame intervals and stability on this device; results are not a certified monitor refresh-rate measurement.

title: Yatzy Online — Free Dice Game & Score Sheet
description: Play a free single-player Yatzy-style dice game. Hold dice, fill 15 scoring categories, track the upper-section bonus and export the score sheet.

title: Microphone Level Meter — Free dBFS Test
description: View microphone RMS and peak levels in dBFS, keep a local history and export CSV. Optional reference calibration is an estimate, not a certified sound-pressure measurement.

title: Bubble Shooter Online — Free Color Match Game
description: Play Bubble Shooter free in your browser. Aim with mouse, touch or keyboard, match colors, clear hanging bubbles, beat levels and try the daily seeded challenge.

title: Pet Age Calculator — Free Dog & Cat Age Guide
description: Compare dog and cat ages with clear methods: an estimated dog life stage or a chart-based cat age comparison. No “multiply by seven” shortcut.

title: Wheel Offset Calculator — Free ET & Rim Position Comparison
description: Compare rim width, wheel offset (ET) and spacers. See inner and outer rim movement, centerline change and optional estimated clearance — a geometry guide, not fitment approval.

title: Scale Drawing Calculator — Free Drawing & Print Scale
description: Calculate real distances from a 1:n drawing scale, convert to a new scale, compare multiple measurements, and print a physical scale bar with a 100 mm check line.

title: Dew Point Calculator — Free Humidity & Condensation Estimate
description: Estimate dew or frost point, absolute humidity and vapour pressure from air temperature and relative humidity. Compare a surface temperature locally in your browser.

title: Natal Chart Calculator — Free Birth Chart & Ascendant
description: Create a free birth chart with Sun, Moon, planetary signs, ascendant and Midheaven. Enter birth time, IANA time zone and coordinates; calculations stay on this device.

title: Numerology Calculator — Free Life Path & Name Numbers
description: Calculate a life path and birthday number, plus optional Pythagorean name numbers. See every reduction step. Free, private and for entertainment only.

title: Jass Online — Free Schieber Game vs CPU
description: Play 12 hands of Schieber Jass against three local computer players. Choose a contract, follow the card rules, keep a score sheet and save your match on this device.

title: Nine Men’s Morris Online — Free Mill Game vs Computer
description: Play Nine Men’s Morris online against a local computer opponent. Place nine pieces, form mills, capture safely and fly when you have three left. Free, private and stored on this device.

title: Halma Online — Free 16×16 Board Game with Jump Chains
description: Play classic two-player Halma online for free. Move 19 pieces across a 16×16 board with eight-direction steps and chained jumps; play a local computer or pass-and-play.

title: Canasta Online — Free Two-Player Card Game
description: Play two-player Canasta against a local computer. Form melds, use wild cards, take or freeze the discard pile, build clean and mixed canastas, and track scores privately on this device.

title: Skat Online — Free Three-Player Card Game vs CPU
description: Practice Skat against two local computer players. Bid, pick up or play Hand, choose a suit, Grand or Null, follow suit and score each deal. Free; play stays on this device.

title: Doppelkopf Online — Free Four-Seat Card Game
description: Play a four-seat Doppelkopf practice game against three local CPUs. Follow suit, find your Re partner, announce Re or Kontra and resolve a wedding. No account; saved on this device.

title: Schafkopf Online — Free Rufspiel Card Game
description: Play a local Bavarian Schafkopf Rufspiel against three computer players. Call an ace, find your hidden partner, follow suit, win tricks and learn the basic rules. Free; saved on this device.

title: Schnapsen Online — Free Austrian 66 Card Game vs CPU
description: Play Austrian Schnapsen with a 20-card deck against a local computer. Declare marriages, exchange the trump jack, close the talon and reach 66. Free; saved on this device.

title: Suguru Online — Free Number Region Puzzle
description: Play Suguru online for free. Fill each outlined region with 1 to its size and keep equal numbers apart, including diagonally. Generate a unique puzzle, use notes and hints, and save progress on this device.

title: Shikaku Puzzle Online — Free Daily Rectangle Game
description: Play Shikaku online for free. Divide each grid into rectangles that match the numbered areas. Get a daily puzzle, hints and a fresh board; your game stays on this device.

title: Brick Breaker Online — Free Paddle and Brick Game
description: Play a free brick breaker game in your browser. Control the paddle with touch, mouse or keyboard, clear original levels, pause any time and save your best score on this device.

title: Mini Golf Online — Free 9-Hole Game & Course Codes
description: Play a free nine-hole mini golf game in your browser. Aim and set putt power, avoid water and bumpers, track strokes and par, then share a reproducible course code. No upload or account.

title: Match 3 Game Online — Free Untimed Match-Three Puzzle
description: Play an original match-3 puzzle with goals, move limits, cascades, hints and 12 levels. No timer or account; progress can stay on this device.

title: Audio to MIDI Converter — Free Melody to MIDI
description: Turn a short recording of one clear melody into editable MIDI notes. Correct pitch and timing, quantize if needed, then export a standard MIDI file in your browser.

title: Vocal Remover — Separate Vocals and Accompaniment Locally
description: Separate a short stereo music sample into estimated vocal and accompaniment WAV stems in your browser. The audio is never uploaded; download the public model on demand.

title: Voice Changer Online — Free Voice Effects in Your Browser
description: Change pitch, shape radio or deep-voice effects, preview echo, and export processed audio locally. Free, private, and no upload.

title: Tone Generator Online — Free Frequency & Sweep Tool
description: Play or export simple audio tones and frequency sweeps. Choose frequency, waveform, duration and mono or stereo WAV; processing stays in your browser.
